en: A monochrome historic postcard view of a European city square with a large, ornate Neo‑Renaissance building featuring a central dome, clock, and corner towers. In front of it stands a multi‑tiered monument with statues, surrounded by an open plaza with café tables and umbrellas. A broad street with tram tracks, early motor vehicles, and pedestrians runs alongside rows of traditional townhouses; a church tower is visible further down the street.
